## New or changed sample

- Folder: `samples/...`

## Checklist

- [ ] The agent ran in an environment; `tested:` in `sample.yml` gives the date, the path tested and the result
- [ ] `version:` in `sample.yml` is new or raised, with its section in `CHANGELOG.md`
- [ ] `python tools/build_docs.py` was run; the overview reads in a minute, the setup can be followed without help
- [ ] The quick try works from the instructions alone, with the messages listed under `quick_try.try`
- [ ] No personal or company data in any file, test message or picture; knowledge files are fictitious
- [ ] English instructions, skills and texts
